cards.ex: It's the police's job to uphold the law, no matter how unpopular it may be.
cards.exUz: Politsiyaning vazifasi qonunni qo'llab-quvvatlash, u qanchalik mashhur bo'lmasin.
cards.uzDef: Qonunni hurmat qilish va uning bajarilishini ta'minlash.

cards.ex: The courts are there to administer justice fairly and impartially.
cards.exUz: Sudlar adolatni xolis va betaraf tarzda o'rnatish uchun mavjud.
cards.uzDef: Sud va qonun orqali adolatni ta'minlash jarayoni.

cards.ex: The CEO's actions raised a question of ethics within the company.
cards.exUz: Bosh direktorning harakatlari kompaniya ichida axloq masalasini ko'tardi.
cards.uzDef: To'g'ri yoki noto'g'ri harakatni aniqlash bilan bog'liq muammo.

cards.ex: The investigation revealed a serious misuse of power within the government.
cards.exUz: Tergov hukumat ichida hokimiyatni jiddiy suiiste'mol qilish holatini aniqladi.
cards.uzDef: O'z vakolatlaridan noto'g'ri, shaxsiy manfaatlar uchun foydalanish.

cards.ex: The judge released the suspect on bail in the interest of justice.
cards.exUz: Sudya adolat yuzasidan gumonlanuvchini garov evaziga ozod qildi.
cards.uzDef: Adolatni ta'minlash maqsadida qilinadigan harakat.

cards.ex: The company exploited a legal loophole to avoid paying taxes.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya soliq to'lashdan qochish uchun qonuniy bo'shliqdan foydalandi.
cards.uzDef: Qonundagi kamchilik, undan foydalanib qonunni chetlab o'tish.

cards.ex: The harsh penalty should serve as a deterrent to future crimes.
cards.exUz: Qattiq jazo kelajakdagi jinoyatlar uchun tiyib turuvchi omil bo'lishi kerak.
cards.uzDef: Boshqalarni xuddi shunday harakatlardan to'xtatuvchi narsa.

cards.ex: It was obvious that rules were bent to favor one of the candidates.
cards.exUz: Nomzodlardan biriga yordam berish uchun qoidalar buzilgani aniq edi.
cards.uzDef: Qoidalar o'zgartirilgan yoki buzilgan, noto'g'ri ish qilingan.

cards.ex: Many feel there's a moral imperative to help those less fortunate.
cards.exUz: Ko'pchilik o'zidan zaifroq odamlarga yordam berish axloqiy zarurat deb hisoblaydi.
cards.uzDef: To'g'ri deb hisoblangan narsani qilish uchun kuchli ichki tuyg'u.

cards.ex: He decided to come clean about his involvement in the scandal.
cards.exUz: U janjalga aloqadorligini tan olishga qaror qildi.
cards.uzDef: Yashiringan narsani, ayniqsa noto'g'ri ishni oshkor qilish.

cards.ex: Everyone deserves to get a fair hearing, regardless of their background.
cards.exUz: Har bir inson, kelib chiqishidan qat'iy nazar, adil eshituvga loyiq.
cards.uzDef: Ishni xolis va adolatli tarzda ko'rib chiqish imkoniyati.

cards.ex: I disagree with the proposal on principle; it's simply unfair.
cards.exUz: Men taklifga prinsipial jihatdan qo'shilmayman; bu oddiygina adolatsizlik.
cards.uzDef: Shaxsiy e'tiqod yoki axloqiy qoidalar asosida.

cards.ex: The former CEO found himself in the dock, accused of fraud.
cards.exUz: Sobiq bosh direktor firibgarlikda ayblanib, sudlanuvchi o'rindig'ida o'tirdi.
cards.uzDef: Sudda ayblanuvchi sifatida javob berish.

cards.ex: Equality before the law is a fundamental principle of our society.
cards.exUz: Qonun oldida tenglik jamiyatimizning asosiy tamoyilidir.
cards.uzDef: Hamma qonun oldida teng huquqli bo'lishi kerakligi.

cards.ex: The judge handed down a severe sentence to the convicted criminal.
cards.exUz: Sudya sudlangan jinoyatchiga qattiq hukm chiqardi.
cards.uzDef: Sud tomonidan jinoyatchiga jazo belgilash.

cards.ex: The authorities can't continue to turn a blind eye to the corruption.
cards.exUz: Hukumat korrupsiyaga e'tibor bermaslikda davom eta olmaydi.
cards.uzDef: Noto'g'ri ishni ko'rmaganga olish, unga qarshi choralar ko'rmaslik.

cards.ex: Releasing the wrongly convicted man can't undo the miscarriage of justice.
cards.exUz: Noto'g'ri hukm qilingan odamni ozod qilish adolatsizlik holatini bartaraf eta olmaydi.
cards.uzDef: Noto'g'ri hukm tufayli begunoh odamning jazolanishi.

cards.ex: His behavior was beyond the pale; he was completely disrespectful.
cards.exUz: Uning xulq-atvori qabul qilib bo'lmas edi; u butunlay hurmatsizlik qildi.
cards.uzDef: Axloqiy jihatdan qabul qilib bo'lmaydigan, ruxsat etilmagan.

cards.ex: If you want to succeed, you have to play by the rules, even when it's difficult.
cards.exUz: Agar muvaffaqiyatga erishmoqchi bo'lsangiz, qiyin bo'lsa ham, qoidalar bo'yicha o'ynashingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Belgilangan qoidalarga rioya qilish, halol ish tutish.

cards.ex: The tribunal was nothing more than a kangaroo court; the outcome was predetermined.
cards.exUz: Tribunal soxta suddan boshqa hech narsa emas edi; natija oldindan belgilab qo'yilgan.
cards.uzDef: Adolatsiz, qonuniy asosga ega bo'lmagan sud.

cards.ex: Justice demands that the guilty parties are held responsible for their actions.
cards.exUz: Adolat aybdor tomonlarning o'z harakatlari uchun javobgar bo'lishini talab qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Adolatni ta'minlash uchun zarur bo'lgan harakat.

cards.ex: His actions were in direct violation of company policy.
cards.exUz: Uning harakatlari kompaniya siyosatining to'g'ridan-to'g'ri buzilishi edi.
cards.uzDef: Qonun, shartnoma yoki qoidaga zid harakat qilish.

cards.ex: The company was held liable for the damages caused by its negligence.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya o'zining beparvoligi tufayli etkazilgan zarar uchun javobgar deb topildi.
cards.uzDef: Qonuniy javobgarlikka tortilish, xatosi uchun to'lov to'lash.

cards.ex: We need to ensure equality of opportunity for all members of society.
cards.exUz: Biz jamiyatning barcha a'zolari uchun imkoniyatlar tengligini ta'minlashimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Hamma uchun bir xil muvaffaqiyatga erishish imkoniyati.

cards.ex: The government is trying to right the scales and provide more support to disadvantaged communities.
cards.exUz: Hukumat tenglikni tiklashga va kam ta'minlangan jamiyatlarga ko'proq yordam ko'rsatishga harakat qilmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Noto'g'ri vaziyatni to'g'rilash, tenglikni ta'minlash.

cards.ex: We need to create a level playing field so that everyone has a fair chance to succeed.
cards.exUz: Biz hamma muvaffaqiyat qozonishi uchun teng sharoit yaratishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Adolatli va teng imkoniyatlar ta'minlangan vaziyat.

cards.ex: The investigation focused on allegations of abuse of authority by senior officials.
cards.exUz: Tergov yuqori lavozimli amaldorlar tomonidan hokimiyatni suiiste'mol qilish haqidagi da'volarga qaratildi.
cards.uzDef: O'z lavozimidan noto'g'ri, shaxsiy manfaatlar uchun foydalanish.

cards.ex: For her, it was a matter of principle; she couldn't compromise her beliefs.
cards.exUz: U uchun bu prinsip masalasi edi; u o'z e'tiqodlaridan voz kecha olmadi.
cards.uzDef: Shaxsiy axloqiy qadriyatlar bilan bog'liq muhim qaror.

cards.ex: Instead of retaliating, they decided to take the moral high ground.
cards.exUz: Qasos olish o'rniga, ular axloqiy ustunlikni egallashga qaror qilishdi.
cards.uzDef: Axloqiy jihatdan to'g'ri harakat qilish, namuna bo'lish.

cards.ex: He operated within the letter of the law, even though his actions were morally questionable.
cards.exUz: U qonun doirasida harakat qildi, garchi uning harakatlari axloqiy jihatdan shubhali bo'lsa ham.
cards.term: within the letter of the law
cards.uzDef: Qonunga to'liq rioya qilgan holda, lekin ruhiga zid bo'lishi mumkin.
